definitions.content: equipment (including, but not limited to, measuring instruments, software, measurement standards, reference materials, reference data, reagents, consumables or auxiliary apparatus) that is required for the correct performance of laboratory activities and that can influence the results

notes.content: In the context of this Document, a measuring instrument is a component of the measuring equipment which plays an important role for measurement.
In the context of this Document, measuring equipment may be considered as being equivalent to measuring system.
